description: Use after cyber_risk_score when the user wants to reduce their risk. Returns every gap with a recommended action, a priority, NIST CSF 2.0 and NIS2 references and a 30/60/90-day roadmap (MFA, encryption, patching, incident response and backups first). Requires ClevSec Pro.

answers.description: Question id to answer, e.g. {"q1": "yes", "q4": "partial"}. Unanswered questions score zero.
